properties.title: Palmer Residential Home
properties.description:
Spacious manufactured home nestled in the quiet community of Palmer, Texas. Enjoy expansive covered concrete porches that stretch the length of the home — ideal for outdoor living under the shade of mature trees that fill the large private yard.

The open-concept interior features a bright kitchen with central island, white cabinetry, vaulted ceilings, and seamless flow into the living area. Located in Ellis County with convenient access to Waxahachie and the greater Dallas–Fort Worth metro while still offering a peaceful residential feel.

This well-loved home has solid character and room to make it your own. Some exterior updates are visible and expected with a property of this age.
features: Large Yard with Mature Shade Trees
